rules.statement: The term 'grant' in section 20 of the Bribery Act should be widely construed to include benefits such as a liquor licence.
rules.supporting_quote: "I am satisfied that the Legislature intended as far as possible to prevent or punish even ordinary citizens who accept gratifications as inducements to influence public officials with a view to acting or not acting in a particular way in the discharge of the official functions. Common sense therefore requires that in paragraph (vi) of s. 20 the expression 'grant or benefit' must be widely construed."
